$comment: A team member's stored fields: the person shape (contract/collections/_person.json), flat. A team member is a record with no login, separate from login accounts, and anyone on the team can be credited as a post's author without an account (the founder's rulings of 18/11/2026). Salt for WordPress keeps its team_member post type. Team has no topics (SC-027) and no page of its own. The editor's order is each platform's own.
label: Team member
